TNNT2+ myocardium with WT1+/ZO-1+ epicardial cells and PECAM1+ endothelium on whole-mount staining
Three-layer architecture with an NKX2-5+ myocardial layer at day 10 (Drakhlis 2021)

protocols.name: Self-assembling heart organoids: three-step Wnt modulation in 96-well plates
protocols.principle: Single hPSC aggregates in U-bottom wells receive a Wnt on/off sequence (CHIR99021 with low BMP4 and Activin A, then Wnt-C59) to form chambered myocardium, followed by a short second CHIR99021 pulse on day 7 that induces epicardial tissue on the outside.

source.authors: Lewis-Israeli YR, Wasserman AH, Gabalski MA, et al.
source.title: Self-assembling human heart organoids for the modeling of cardiac development and congenital heart disease.

protocols.efficiency: Beating organoids from day 6 and robust, regular beating in all organoids by day 10
protocols.start_requirements: hPSCs in Essential 8 Flex. Day -2: seed 10,000 cells per well of a round-bottom ultra-low-attachment 96-well plate in 100 µl E8 Flex + 2 µM thiazovivin, spin 100 g for 3 min. Day -1: remove 50 µl and add 200 µl fresh E8 Flex.

stages.name: Mesoderm induction
actions: Remove 166 µl (about two thirds) of the medium from each well and add 166 µl of factor-containing medium

stages.name: Rest
actions: Replace 166 µl with fresh medium

stages.name: Cardiac specification (Wnt off)
actions: Two-thirds change with Wnt-C59 medium

stages.name: Cardiomyocyte differentiation
stages.base_medium: RPMI 1640 + B-27 minus insulin until day 6, then RPMI 1640 + B-27
actions: Introduce insulin-containing B-27 on day 6, not earlier
stages.checkpoint: First beating from about day 6.

stages.name: Epicardial induction and maturation

factors.name: CHIR99021
factors.conc: 2 µM for 1 h on day 7 only
factors.role: Second Wnt pulse; induces pro-epicardial cells

stages.feeding: After the 1 h pulse, change medium every 48 h
actions: On day 7 add CHIR99021 for 1 h, then replace with plain medium
Maintain until analysis (day 15 in the paper)
stages.checkpoint: All organoids beating by day 10; clearer sarcomeres and internal chambers by day 15.

tips: One organoid per well makes the method compatible with plate-based imaging and screening.
Never aspirate completely; all changes are partial (166 µl of 250 µl) to avoid losing or damaging the organoid.
The same authors published step-by-step versions (J Vis Exp 2021, PMID 34605811; Curr Protoc 2022, PMID 35723517).
pitfalls: CHIR99021 dose is line-dependent; because changes are partial, calculate the final in-well concentration.
Organoids contain several cardiac lineages (myocardial, epicardial, endocardial/endothelial, fibroblast), so whole-organoid readouts are not cardiomyocyte-specific.
unverified: No cell-type composition percentages were captured.

protocols.name: Heart-forming organoids: Matrigel-embedded aggregates with CHIR99021 then IWP2
protocols.principle: A single hPSC aggregate is embedded in a Matrigel droplet and taken through a standard Wnt on/off cardiac differentiation; the matrix lets it pattern into layers with myocardium, endocardial-like cells, septum-transversum-like tissue, foregut endoderm and a vascular network.

source.authors: Drakhlis L, Biswanath S, Farr CM, et al.
source.title: Human heart-forming organoids recapitulate early heart and foregut development.

protocols.start_requirements: hPSCs in E8 on Geltrex. Day -4: seed 5,000 cells per well of a U-bottom ultra-low-attachment 96-well plate in E8 + 10 µM Y-27632, spin 300 g for 3 min at 4 °C. Day -2: embed each aggregate in a Matrigel droplet, let it set for 1 h, add E8.

stages.name: Mesoderm induction
actions: Replace E8 with CHIR99021 medium

stages.name: Rest
actions: Replace with plain medium

stages.name: Cardiac specification (Wnt off)
actions: Add IWP2 medium on day 3

stages.name: Progenitor stage
actions: Replace with plain medium

stages.name: Organoid maturation
actions: Switch to complete B-27 on day 7
Analyse between day 10 and day 13
stages.checkpoint: Three-layered organoid (inner core, myocardial layer, outer layer); NKX2-5+ myocardial layer.

tips: An NKX2-5-eGFP reporter line makes the myocardial layer easy to follow.
The authors listed the Matrigel lots that worked, a sign that lot testing is needed.
pitfalls: Only 5,000 cells per aggregate formed organoids; 500, 3,500 and 10,000 failed.
These organoids deliberately contain foregut endoderm (SOX17/SOX2/HNF4A regions) as well as cardiac tissue; they are a model of early heart-foregut development, not a pure cardiac tissue.
unverified: Feeding interval between day 7 and day 10 was not captured.
No quantitative success rate captured from the text read.

cell_types.notes: Organoid-to-organoid variability is real; analyse many organoids per condition. The cavity-forming 'cardioid' method of Hofbauer et al. 2021 Cell (PMID 34019794, doi 10.1016/j.cell.2021.04.034) is an important third option, but its Methods could not be accessed for verification, so it is not listed as a protocol here; the authors' preprint notes that the CHIR99021 concentration is cell-line dependent.
